description: A 16 by 16 matrix mixing the channels of one polyphonic input into the channels of one polyphonic output.

params.text: Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16.
Sets how much of one input channel is mixed into one output channel.

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels the matrix mixes.

outputs.text: The polyphonic result of the matrix.

notes: every coefficient starts at zero, so the output is silent until you turn some of them up, or fill the matrix from the Presets item on the menu.
right-clicking a coefficient knob gives this menu with the row, the column and the one cell added: Copy Row, Copy Column and Copy Cell, and a Paste matching whichever of those was copied.
the coefficient knob's menu also carries Paste Multiply, Paste Add and Paste Subtract, which combine the copied values with the ones already in the matrix rather than replacing them.
the coefficient knob's menu also carries Normalize Column, which scales that one column so that it totals 1; the maker spells that item with a z and the others with an s.
menu: Copy — copies the whole matrix of coefficients.
Paste — writes the copied coefficients back into the matrix; it appears only after a Copy.
Presets — a submenu of Identity, which puts 1 down the diagonal, and Upper and Lower, which fill one triangle of the matrix with 1 and the other with 0.
Normalise — a submenu of Normalise, which scales every coefficient so that they total 1, and Normalise All Columns, which scales each column so that it totals 1.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
